description: End-to-end health check of the Omnicord setup: token presence and validity, privileged gateway intent toggles, guild count against Discord's verification thresholds, and default guild membership. Every failed check comes with instructions for fixing it. With more than one bot configured, pass bot to check a specific one. Run this first when anything misbehaves.

bot.description: Which bot to act as, by name, when more than one is configured. Omit to use the default bot.

name: run_setup_check
title: Run setup check
